facts.summary: Phase 3 failed interim overall survival analysis, development stopped · Phase 3 · nemvaleukin alfa plus Keytruda in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: nemvaleukin in combination with pembrolizumab did not achieve a statistically significant improvement in overall survival versus investigator’s choice chemotherapy alone
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: nemvaleukin in combination with pembrolizumab did not achieve a statistically significant improvement in overall survival versus investigator’s choice chemotherapy alone
evidence.safety: Nemvaleukin has a well characterized and favorable safety profile, both as a monotherapy and in combination with pembrolizumab, with over 800 patients treated across the broader clinical program.
evidence.program_discontinued: will not continue to final analysis and the Company will cease development of nemvaleukin for PROC
